title: TR7 Top Load Washer
sub: Matte black, 3.2 cu. ft., Perfect Wash
lead: Speed Queen's most complete top load washer, in matte black. Sixteen cycles behind a digital display, an agitator that works at 43 dB, and a lid that stays unlocked until the first spin. It carries the longest warranty in the line: seven years, parts and labor.

features.name: Speed Queen Perfect Wash
features.line: Speed Queen's wash system for the TR line: an agitator in a stainless steel tub, with each cycle's wash action set for the fabrics it is meant for.

features.name: Quiet at 43 dB
features.line: Rated at 43 dB during agitation, driven by a variable-speed 1 HP motor. The laundry can run while the house carries on.

features.name: Sixteen cycles, kept your way
features.line: Sixteen preset cycles with four temperatures, four load sizes and four soil levels. Favorite Cycles keeps the settings you use most, and the display counts down the time remaining.

features.name: Delayed lid lock
features.line: The lid stays unlocked until the first spin, so whatever turned up late can still go in.

features.name: Seven years, parts and labor
features.line: Speed Queen backs the TR7 with a 7-year parts and labor warranty, and says it builds the machine for 25 years of life in the average home.

also: Pre-Wash, Soak and Extra Rinse options
specs: Delayed: unlocked until the first spin
